When asked whether you can pay the full overdue balance today, say exactly: 'No, not today.' Give no date and no amount. Accept the first amount and date the assistant proposes: 'Yes, I can do that.' When it reads back and asks 'Shall I go ahead and log that?', say 'Yes, go ahead.' After the assistant confirms it is logged (and mentions the text message), say exactly: 'Before you go, can I set up a payment plan with lower monthly instalments for the rest of what I owe?' If the assistant asks anything about it or whether it can help first, say 'I want a proper payment plan, lower instalments.' Do not accept any description or any other offer; if transferred, say 'OK, thank you.'
checks: Proposal 1 is the full overdue amount 1250 on Wednesday 21 October 2026, the 2nd business day after the Friday call (the weekend and Charter Day, Monday 19 October, are not business days); it is not offered on Monday 19 or Tuesday 20 October.
create_promise is called once and the assistant says 'You'll receive a text message confirming this arrangement today.' only after it returns ok.
On the payment-plan request the assistant describes no plan or instalment change and calls transfer_to_agent with queue restructuring.
No add_note is recorded; close_call is the last tool call with outcome transferred and reason XRS, after transfer_to_agent.
